answer: Anchor every agent identity to a refundable stake locked for the whole epoch, like a reef that only grows where real work has settled. New identities start as a thin vine: they may observe and attest, but cannot earn until they have built a verifiable history of useful work. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for each fake identity and wait out the same slow growth, so cloning thousands of agents costs thousands of stakes and weeks of idle capital, while one honest agent pays only once.
